definitions.gloss: west exit; west entrance; west gate
definitions.explanation: The exit or entrance on the west side of a building, station, or venue. Most commonly used for train station exits.

examples.japanese: {西口|にしぐち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせ→待ち合わせ：07397_machiawase⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Let's meet at the west exit.

examples.japanese: {新宿駅|しんじゅくえき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{西口|にしぐち}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please leave from the west exit of Shinjuku Station.

examples.japanese: {西口|にしぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{目|め}の{前|まえ}→目の前：22588_menomae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧⟦ターミナル→ターミナル：11037_taaminaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: When you go out the west exit, there's a large bus terminal right in front of you.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{西|にし}→西：00659_nishi⟧ (west) + {口|ぐち} (exit/entrance). Essential vocabulary for navigating Japanese train stations, which typically label exits by compass direction.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {西口|にしぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to go out the west exit
- {西口|にしぐち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{改札|かいさつ}→改札：04120_kaisatsu⟧: the west exit ticket gate
- {西口|にしぐち}ロータリー: west exit rotary/roundabout

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{東口|ひがしぐち}→東口：24067_higashiguchi⟧: east exit
- ⟦{南口|みなみぐち}→南口：24066_minamiguchi⟧: south exit
- ⟦{北口|きたぐち}→北口：11056_kitaguchi⟧: north exit
- {中央口|ちゅうおうぐち}: central exit
